assert psutil.virtual_memory().available>52*2**30

with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):

 gpu=copy.deepcopy(cpu).cuda();values=torch.randn((1,39,16,20),generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(17103))
outputs=[];gradients=[]
for module,device in [(cpu,'cpu'),(gpu,'cuda')]:
 value=values.to(device).detach().requires_grad_();out=module(value);out.square().mean().backward();outputs.append(out.detach().cpu());gradients.append(value.grad.detach().cpu());assert all(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in module.parameters());zero=[n for n,p in module.named_parameters() if p.grad.abs().max()==0];assert len(zero)==50 and all('.offset_cnn.cnn.' in n and not '.cnn.10.' in n for n in zero),zero
torch.testing.assert_close(outputs[0],outputs[1],rtol=3e-4,atol=3e-6)
torch.testing.assert_close(gradients[0],gradients[1],rtol=2e-3,atol=1e-8)
parity=dict(output_maximum_difference=float((outputs[0]-outputs[1]).abs().max()),input_gradient_maximum_difference=float((gradients[0]-gradients[1]).abs().max()),all141_parameter_gradients_finite=True,initial_zero_hidden_offset_tensors=50)

optimizer=torch.optim.AdamW(module.network.parameters(),lr=.0003);counts=dict(wrapper=0,frozen=0,network=0,sampler=0)
module.register_forward_hook(lambda *args:counts.__setitem__('wrapper',counts['wrapper']+1));module.frozen.register_forward_hook(lambda *args:counts.__setitem__('frozen',counts['frozen']+1));module.network.register_forward_hook(lambda *args:counts.__setitem__('network',counts['network']+1))
for m in module.network.modules():
 if type(m).__name__=='NonlocalBlock':m.register_forward_hook(lambda *args:counts.__setitem__('sampler',counts['sampler']+1))
shapes=[]
for iteration,(batch,size) in enumerate([(4,512),(4,512),(4,512),(1,768)]):
 generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(17110+iteration)
 parent=(torch.rand((batch,3,size,size),generator=generator)*.01+.005).cuda();packed=(torch.rand((batch,4,size//2,size//2),generator=generator)*.012+.004).cuda();variance=packed*.00128+6.5536e-6;colors=color_indices('RGGB')[None].expand(batch,-1).cuda();wb=torch.tensor([[1.5,1.,1.2]],device='cuda').expand(batch,-1)
 torch.cuda.synchronize();started=time.perf_counter()
 if iteration<3:
  output,aux=module(parent,packed,variance,colors,wb,return_aux=True)
  if iteration==0:assert torch.equal(output,aux['frozen_output'])
  loss=((output-parent)/variance.mean((1,2,3),keepdim=True).sqrt()).square().mean();loss.backward()
  assert all(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in module.network.parameters())
  if iteration==2:assert all(p.grad.abs().max()>0 for p in module.network.parameters())

 assert torch.isfinite(output).all() and model_hash(module.frozen)==frozen and not any(p.grad is not None for p in module.frozen.parameters())
 shapes.append(dict(batch=batch,native=size,backward=iteration<3,seconds=elapsed,peak_CUDA_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),counts=dict(counts)));print('Real-shape synthetic',shapes[-1],flush=True)
 del parent,packed,variance,colors,wb,output
 if iteration<3:del aux,loss
assert counts==dict(wrapper=4,frozen=4,network=4,sampler=20)

 admission_full_network_CPU_calls=3,admission_full_network_CUDA_calls=6,admission_frozen_component_CUDA_calls=4,admission_native_sampler_only_CPU_calls=4,admission_native_sampler_only_CUDA_calls=4,discarded_synthetic_optimizer_updates=3,previous_failed_admissions=[ref(root/'admission-failure-v1.json'),ref(root/'admission-failure-v2.json')],
